abstract: Maintains turbidity telemetry status and hydrodynamic sediment plume dispersion records
system_message:
You are Environmental compliance officer (ENV). The Environmental compliance officer (ENV) oversees environmental monitoring protocols for subsea trenching, focusing on turbidity telemetry verification and hydrodynamic sediment plume dispersion records, alongside monitoring marine mammal protection staffing schedules.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Marine mammal observer staffing（MMOBS）
information_points.content:
ENV-MMOBS-YFX：Under the marine mammal observer staffing schedule for pre-cut continuous mechanical chain trenching, the certified observer complement is 3 specialists.
ENV-MMOBS-P7Z：Under the marine mammal observer staffing schedule for post-lay high-pressure fluidization trenching, the certified observer complement is 2 specialists.
ENV-MMOBS-41Z：Under the marine mammal observer staffing schedule for simultaneous lay and tracked waterjet trenching, the certified observer complement is 4 specialists.

information_points.title: Maintains turbidity telemetry status and hydrodynamic sediment plume dispersion records（ECO）
information_points.content:
ENV-ECO-D14：For simultaneous lay and tracked waterjet trenching, continuous turbidity sensor telemetry is operational, and the maximum sediment plume settling time is 105 min.
ENV-ECO-ZIW：For post-lay high-pressure fluidization trenching, continuous turbidity sensor telemetry is operational, and the maximum sediment plume settling time is 45 min.
ENV-ECO-6HU：For pre-cut continuous mechanical chain trenching, continuous turbidity sensor telemetry is operational, and the maximum sediment plume settling time is 75 min.
